name: JustRoute autorouter
description: Batch autorouter: routes the unrouted nets of the open board around existing copper, then adds the result as a single undoable commit. CPU-only, DRC-certified engine.

actions.name: Route board
actions.description: Route the board's unrouted nets (existing tracks, vias, and rule areas are honored; netclass widths come from the project file). With tracks/pads/nets SELECTED, routes only the selected nets.

actions.name: Autorouter settings
actions.description: Edit JustRoute preferences for this project (budget, effort, pour-fed nets, grid) — writes justroute.json next to the board.
